name: Idle Physio: Clinic Tycoon
summary:
Build the Ultimate Physiotherapy Clinic!

Start with a small treatment room and transform it into a world-class rehabilitation center. Manage patients, hire skilled staff, unlock new departments, and grow your healthcare empire in this fun and addictive idle tycoon game!

As a physiotherapist, your mission is simple: help patients recover while building the most successful clinic in town.
